constexprRangeAdlCheckpoint.repair: Resolve free range-for begin/end using associated lookup without ordinary scope candidates, emit selected calls in shared lowering, and select member lookup when both names exist even for nonfunction members.
constexprRangeAdlCheckpoint.controls: Member pointer iteration, exactly-once range evaluation, temporary mutation/expiry, ADL begin/end with distinct pointer types, ordinary deleted candidates ignored, one member name permitting ADL and two enum member names blocking ADL pass.
constexprRangeAdlCheckpoint.limitations: Class iterator/sentinel combinations, broader hidden-friend/template/access lookup, nontrivial range lifetime and existing Size/index fallback remain unaudited. Full C++17 language/library inventory is incomplete.

constexprAggregateCopyExpressionCheckpoi.repair: Evaluate same-type aggregate copy-expression initializers through existing field/relocation-preserving list-copy initialization. Reject copying a destination own uninitialized scalar storage.
constexprAggregateCopyExpressionCheckpoi.controls: Independent copy mutation, reference-returning initializer evaluated once and aggregate self-read rejection pass.
constexprAggregateCopyExpressionCheckpoi.limitations: Class-sentinel constexpr range test remains a positive failing reproducer; aggregate return-value evaluation requires investigation. Fast gate is not green. Full C++17 inventory remains incomplete.

constexprAggregateReturnCheckpoint.repair: Give evaluated aggregate returns independent result storage, validate stored references before releasing callee objects, and clean pending results during recovery. Evaluate eligible member aggregate calls and unary/free operator calls; preserve constexpr specifiers consumed by constructor lookahead and retain discarded runtime-call failures.
constexprAggregateReturnCheckpoint.controls: Class iterator with distinct sentinel now passes. Aggregate prvalue/named return copies preserve independent array storage; pointers to callee locals and discarded runtime iterator increments reject.
constexprAggregateReturnCheckpoint.limitations: Remaining aggregate-return call paths, nontrivial construction, mandatory elision/self-reference lifetime, union/bitfield/reference-field coverage and full C++17 language/library inventory remain incomplete.

constexprAggregateReturnArgumentsCheckpo.repair: Enable aggregate constexpr results in free-function calls with arguments and shared operator call completion, omitting ABI hidden result-address arguments from evaluator parameter binding.
constexprAggregateReturnArgumentsCheckpo.controls: Small and larger aggregate returns, distinct argument values, free operator results, caller-owned pointer mutation and rejection of pointers to value parameters pass.
constexprAggregateReturnArgumentsCheckpo.limitations: Nontrivial construction, mandatory elision/self-reference lifetime, remaining indirect/virtual call behavior, union/bitfield/reference-field coverage and full C++17 inventory remain incomplete.

constexprIndirectAggregateCheckpoint.repair: Read known function-pointer values before lowering indirect call targets, and accept constant pointer values as evaluated expression statements and loop increments.
constexprIndirectAggregateCheckpoint.controls: Aggregate calls through pointer parameters, conditional reassignment, loop-increment reassignment and discarded indirect runtime aggregate-call rejection pass.
constexprIndirectAggregateCheckpoint.limitations: Member-function pointers, further indirect-call forms, nontrivial construction, copy-elision/self-reference lifetime and full C++17 inventory remain incomplete.

constexprMemberFunctionPointerCheckpoint.repair: Preserve known nonvirtual member-function targets and receiver identities during constant binding, preserve function-address relocations in member-pointer storage, and pass evaluated receivers into ordinary constexpr calls. NRVO now uses the function being analyzed instead of stale exception-handling function state.
constexprMemberFunctionPointerCheckpoint.controls: Scalar calls through dot-star and arrow-star, mutation, const static receiver and discarded runtime-call rejection pass. Member/free return ABI regression passes. Saved crashing batch completes under the native debugger after the NRVO repair.
constexprMemberFunctionPointerCheckpoint.limitations: Member-pointer inheritance adjustment, reassignment, aggregate result forms, additional access/ref qualification and virtual-call rules need coverage. Full C++17 language/library inventory remains incomplete.

constexprDerivedMemberPointerCheckpoint.repair: Apply derived-to-base receiver adjustment during constant member binding, preserve target relocations and encoded offsets in evaluated member-pointer conversions, retain member ABI on synthesized bound-call prototypes and reject ambiguous declaring bases.
constexprDerivedMemberPointerCheckpoint.controls: Aggregate result through nonzero-offset base receiver, converted member-pointer copy, original pointer preservation, runtime agreement and ambiguous receiver rejection pass.
constexprDerivedMemberPointerCheckpoint.limitations: Member-pointer access/ref qualification, mixed virtual-base paths, assignment/null/comparison operations, nontrivial aggregate return construction and full C++17 inventory remain incomplete.

memberPointerBaseAccessCheckpoint.repair: Check declaring-base accessibility before both constant and runtime member-pointer binding. Walk inheritance paths using lexical member/friend context and protected-base access.
memberPointerBaseAccessCheckpoint.controls: Reject external private-base binding and private-base access from a further descendant. Permit members, free friends, nested classes and protected-base derived members.
memberPointerBaseAccessCheckpoint.limitations: Member-pointer conversion access, further mixed virtual-base and template/friend contexts, ref qualification, assignment/null/comparison operations and full C++17 inventory remain incomplete.

memberPointerConversionAccessCheckpoint.repair: Apply access, ambiguity and nonvirtual-base checks in contextual member-address folding and ordinary member-pointer conversions. Isolate named-cast operands from outer initializer context and preserve source-owner overload selection during reinterpretation.
memberPointerConversionAccessCheckpoint.controls: Private-base implicit/static conversions, ambiguous bases and virtual-base conversions reject; member/friend conversions and inaccessible-class reinterpret round trips pass.
memberPointerConversionAccessCheckpoint.limitations: C-style cast distinctions, mixed virtual-base paths, further template/access/ref-qualification cases, member-pointer assignment/null/comparison semantics and the full C++17 inventory remain incomplete.

memberPointerCStyleCastCheckpoint.repair: Distinguish C-style member-pointer conversions from static and reinterpret casts, waiving base accessibility only for C-style static conversions while retaining ambiguity and virtual-base constraints. Suspend outer member-address context while parsing C-style operands.
memberPointerCStyleCastCheckpoint.controls: Nonzero-offset private-base conversion, inverse round trip and calls through both pointer types pass. Ambiguous and virtual-base C-style conversions reject.
memberPointerCStyleCastCheckpoint.limitations: Remaining cv-combination and overload cases, mixed virtual-base paths, member-pointer assignment/null/comparison semantics and full C++17 inventory remain incomplete.

constexprMemberPointerBoolCheckpoint.repair: Evaluate member-pointer boolean conversions from stored target/adjustment words, preserve constant null storage, and route logical negation through boolean conversion. Remove a stray address-flags diagnostic.
constexprMemberPointerBoolCheckpoint.controls: Function/data member presence, offset-zero data member, nullptr and empty-list initialization, nonzero-base converted null and discarded null-call rejection pass.
constexprMemberPointerBoolCheckpoint.limitations: Member-pointer equality/assignment, further virtual representation and cv/overload cases, and full C++17 inventory remain incomplete.

constexprMemberPointerEqualityCheckpoint.repair: Convert both equality operands to the composite member-pointer type and evaluate known target relocations and adjustment words before runtime lowering.
constexprMemberPointerEqualityCheckpoint.controls: Same/different data members, same/different function targets, nullptr in either position and base-to-derived common-type comparison with nonzero offset pass.
constexprMemberPointerEqualityCheckpoint.limitations: Assignment, further virtual/union representation comparisons, cv/overload cases and full C++17 inventory remain incomplete.

constexprMemberPointerAssignmentCheckpoi.repair: Track both converted member-pointer words and function relocation in constexpr assignment to evaluation-owned storage, preserving destination lvalue identity and validating constness and evaluated source values before writes.
constexprMemberPointerAssignmentCheckpoi.controls: Data and function reassignment, nonzero base conversion, self-assignment, chained assignment and null reassignment pass at compile time and runtime. Direct diagnostics confirm const-object mutation and non-constexpr source assignment rejection.
constexprMemberPointerAssignmentCheckpoi.limitations: Further virtual/union representation comparisons, cv/overload cases, aggregate subobject assignment and the remaining C++17 inventory are incomplete.
